correctness.rationale: Two edge-disjoint arcs connect each vertex pair, so probability of connectivity equals sum of their Bernoulli edge-product probabilities minus global-product probability. The resulting uniform-seed mean is a cyclic contiguous-interval product sum. Expanding each product in delta=p−q, only quadratic contributions depend on high-edge separation d; cyclic interval pair count C_k(d) yields μ_d−μ_{d+1}=2delta²/n sum_{k=d+1}^{n−d−1}q^(k−2)>0. For C4, only adjacent-versus-opposite two-open-bond configurations affect the two placements, giving first and second raw-moment differences delta²/2 and 3delta². Their variance sign becomes sign F(p,q); derivative F_p is negative at endpoints and affine, establishing strict monotonicity, unique critical p when q_L<q<q_U, and outer fixed-sign zones. Independently enumerated full bond states for small n using exact fractions.
